articles.title: Northern Railway’s Jammu division introduces lead wire sealing in parcel SLRs
articles.summary: Northern Railway’s Jammu division has significantly enhanced security and safety by introducing lead wire sealing in parcel SLRs. This measure aims to reduce fire accident risks and improve overall operational security. Such proactive steps underline the commitment to modernizing railway safety protocols, ensuring safer national transport of goods and passengers through continuous infrastructure and procedural improvements.

articles.title: Harbor Freight In-Store: 12 Days of Deals: 35-pc ICON Flex-Head Ratchet & Bit Set $25 & More (Valid Daily thru 12/23)
articles.summary: The ICON MEME 35pc tool set, a viral product that gained significant internet traction, will be available for $25 on Dec 13th, with a limit of one per customer. This widely popular item has inspired thousands of online videos, unique 3D printed accessories, and dedicated community groups, showcasing its widespread appeal and adaptability among enthusiasts for various projects.

articles.title: Three suspected spies including retired IAF official arrested
articles.summary: Security agencies in Assam and Arunachal Pradesh have arrested three suspected spies, including a retired Indian Air Force staff member from Tezpur. This major crackdown highlights ongoing efforts to counter espionage threats within India, especially concerning sensitive border regions. The arrests underscore the vigilance required to protect national security interests from internal and external threats.

articles.title: Fighting rages on Thai-Cambodian border despite Trump's ceasefire claim
articles.summary: Intense border fighting erupted between Thailand and Cambodia on Saturday, challenging earlier declarations by U.S. President Donald Trump, who claimed to have successfully mediated a ceasefire. The renewed hostilities underscore persistent territorial disputes and highlight the difficulties in achieving lasting peace, even with international diplomatic intervention.

articles.title: AIIMS Delhi conducts India's first dedicated clinical trial of advanced brain stent
articles.summary: AIIMS Delhi has achieved a significant milestone in Indian healthcare by conducting the country's first dedicated clinical trial of an advanced brain stent. This cutting-edge device is specifically designed for treating severe strokes, promising improved outcomes for patients. This pioneering trial positions India at the forefront of neurological intervention and advanced medical technology, enhancing the nation's stroke care capabilities, marking a crucial step forward for medical science.

articles.title: Blue Jays Sign Elite Veteran Reliever With 1.98 ERA
articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays have strengthened their bullpen by signing free agent submariner Tyler Rogers. While not the high-profile closer like Edwin Diaz or Robert Suarez they initially pursued, Rogers brings unique pitching talent. His addition is expected to significantly bolster the team's pitching depth and provide a valuable asset for the upcoming season, improving their competitive standing.

articles.title: 2 killed in Russia, Ukraine's energy infrastructure targeted as peace talks press on
articles.summary: Recent escalation in the Russia-Ukraine conflict saw a drone attack in Russia's Saratov region kill two people. Simultaneously, parts of Ukraine experienced widespread power outages due to targeted assaults on critical energy infrastructure. These incidents highlight the ongoing intensity of the conflict and its impact on civilian areas and vital services in both nations, showcasing the continuous military engagement.
